Pairing works like it does in BombVault, on a Pairing page of its own, and a group can be managed in one list. The Android app reads QR codes with free software, takes a name of its own and follows a default instance, and it is ready for F-Droid. Every change is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

Instances of this version refuse a relay call that is not stamped against being sent again, so update the app and the browser extension together with your instances. The Android app is `knightloader.halleluja.design`, a new package: Android installs it next to an older copy, which you remove once you have paired the new one.

## ✨ Added

- **A Pairing page under Settings.** Generate a phrase or enter one in a window, with the twelve words checked against the word list as you type, a Paste button and the QR code for the app. Pairing works without a login password; the page says what that means when none is set.
- **One list for the whole group.** The Pairing page lists this instance, the other instances, instances added by address, and every phone and browser extension, each with Connected or Not connected and a Remove button. A removed phone or extension drops its connections and joins again when the phrase is entered there again; a removed instance leaves the group and forgets the phrase.
- **Instances of a group on one network talk directly**, without going through the relay.
- **The browser extension has a card on the Instances page**, like the phone, and every card shows its kind in a badge beside its state: the Docker whale, a screen, a phone or a browser.
- **The addresses of every instance on the Instances page.**
- **A name for the phone.** Settings > This device in the app sets the name the phone goes by on every instance.
- **A default instance in the app,** marked with a star. The app opens on it and takes its look from it, and tapping the star on another instance makes that one the default.
- **Four more captcha solvers: CapMonster Cloud, CapSolver, 9kw.eu and DeathByCaptcha.** Every key is checked against the service before it is saved, and the keys live on the Accounts page.
- **A Torrents card on the Overview** with the speeds, what came in and went out today and in all, the ratio and the three torrents uploading fastest. A torrent still downloading reads Leeching and has a filter of its own.
- **`-version`** on the server and the relay prints the version and exits.
- **The browser extension installs from the Chrome Web Store and Edge Add-ons**, linked from the README and the Apps page.

## 🎨 Design

- **Lists as dense as JDownloader's.** A row in Downloads and the link collector is 28 pixels tall instead of 48, and Row height under Appearance goes back to Medium or Comfortable.
- **The label setting is four:** buttons, sidebar, tabs and the bottom bar each choose their own.
- **Page tabs stay on one row** and drop to their glyphs when the names do not fit.
- **The Settings tiles take the sidebar's colours**, and the Settings pages come in a new order.
- **In the app** the star and the state badge sit at the end of each card, the phrase field and the word slots are larger, the phrase page scrolls as a whole, the look options are dimmed while the app follows its default instance, and Problems sits above About.

## ⚡ Improved

- **The QR scanner in the app is free software.** It reads the camera's live frames with ZXing instead of Google's ML Kit, which sent usage diagnostics to Google, and measures focus and exposure on the middle of the frame, so a code on a bright screen is found in about a second.
- **The Android app is smaller:** the release build runs R8.
- **The Android app can be built by F-Droid** from source, without any of Google's libraries.
- **A relay cannot deliver a call again.** Every sealed call carries its id and the time it was sealed, and an instance runs it once and only within two minutes of its own clock.
- **The relay reads at most 4 KiB from a connection** until it has said hello.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Cancel leaves the QR scanner with the first tap.**
- **A phone that has gone away no longer keeps a card nobody can remove.**

## 🌐 Translations

- The new texts in all 42 languages, in the web interface and the app.
